label: sparse conjunction: l (or d/j/t/3) after context rich in p/1/h/f/u
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.04% of steps) with weak, diffuse structure. About 44% of mass is at the first copy step after <DEL> (recall_idx==1), strongly enriched when the first original token is l (12x lift). The rest sits in the original phase at t=3-10, enriched for inputs l/d/j/t/3 when the previous one or two inputs are p/u/f/h/1. Both parts seem to need a prefix containing several of p,1,h,f,u, but no simple predicate captures this: precision stays below 15% (most steps after DEL with input l do not fire), and the best F1 is about 0.17. Activations are small (mean 0.13 of the gate scale), and I found nothing clear that sets magnitude. It never fires at t=0-1, in the later copy steps (recall_idx>=5), or after a copy error.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=u (+3.91), phase=2 & in_tok=l (+3.61), phase=0 & in_tok=j (+3.44), in_tok=d (+3.20), prev_tok=p (+2.99), orig3=h (+2.91). Lower it: in_tok=1 (-3.58), prev3_tok=- (-2.70), recall_idx=6 (-2.58), recall_idx=7 (-2.32).
